title: Stage secrets on a separate plane and retire them after use
summary: Bearer tokens and credentials are not ordinary job environment. The controller carries a secret reference, resolves it through an authorized secret provider, stages it through a separate secret channel, and retires the staged value after the job. Never put a Hugging Face token or similar credential into the job specification, command argv, generated driver source, ordinary environment map, artifact manifest or logs. Evidence records the secret reference and a redacted retirement event, never the value.
evidence_note: Live Secret Broker v0.2 / Colab Job v0.2 path used huggingface.primary -> HF_MODEL_READ_TOKEN, staged separately from ordinary environment and emitted SECRET_RETIRE with <REDACTED> evidence.
invariants: Secret reference identity may be logged; secret material may not.
Missing/empty required secret fails before allocation when possible.
Generated source must not contain bearer values.
Secret retirement runs on success and failure.
